lines.beaver_en: Minsu, how was your trip to Jeju?
lines.en: It was great. The scenery was really beautiful.

lines.learner: 폭포가 제일 좋았어요. 물소리가 정말 컸어요.
lines.en: The waterfall was the best. The sound of water was so loud.
lines.roman: Pokpoga jeil joasseoyo. Mulssoriga jeongmal keosseoyo.

lines.en: Yes, both the river and the sea were very clear.

lines.beaver_en: What did you do at the sea?
lines.en: I walked on the sand at the beach.
The sea was blue and sparkling.

lines.beaver_en: Did you climb a mountain too?
lines.en: Yes, the air was fresh at the mountaintop.

lines.beaver_en: Did you see the night sky?
lines.en: I saw stars and a full moon from a hill.

lines.beaver_en: I saw a half moon last week.
lines.learner: 반달도 예쁘죠. 바다 위의 달도 멋있었어요.
lines.en: Half moons are pretty too. The moon over the sea was great.
lines.roman: Bandaldo yeppeujyo. Bada wiui daldo meosisseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you see anything else amazing?
lines.learner: 땅속에 큰 동굴도 있었어요. 정말 신기했어요.
lines.en: There was a big cave underground. It was amazing.
lines.roman: Ttangsoge keun dongguldo isseosseoyo. Jeongmal singihaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Hearing this makes me want to go too.
lines.learner: 제주도 자연에 대한 책을 빌려 줄게요.
lines.en: I'll lend you a book about Jeju's nature.
lines.roman: Jejudo jayeone daehan chaegeul billyeo julkkeyo.
